items.name: Unified prediction markets trading platform
items.claim: Interactive Brokers announced the launch of a first-of-its-kind unified interface for trading prediction markets across three leading US prediction market platforms: Kalshi, CME Group, and ForecastEx, giving clients access to the combined liquidity of all three venues from a single platform.
items.source_excerpt: Interactive Brokers (Nasdaq: IBKR), a leading global automated broker, today announced the launch of a first-of-its-kind unified interface for trading prediction markets across three leading US prediction market platforms — Kalshi, CME Group, and ForecastEx. IBKR's Prediction Markets offering enables investors to access and trade contracts across all three prediction market exchanges from a single platform, alongside a broad range of asset classes including stocks, options, forex, futures, crypto

notes: Stored web_doc from IBKR's own media relations release covers the May 2026 unified prediction-markets platform launch. No RPO/backlog figure disclosed in the stored text.
